title: Embedding a directory
hints: Put //go:embed templates directly above var files embed.FS. Embedding a directory leaves out files whose names start with . or _, which is what you want here.
fs.ReadDir(files, "templates") lists the embedded entries in sorted order. Return their Name()s.
template.ParseFS(files, "templates/*.tmpl") parses them all, naming each template after its file name, and tmpl.ExecuteTemplate(&b, name, data) renders one.
